title: Neural network app screens for rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis in Indonesia
summary: An artificial neural network (CUHAS-ROBUST) built on 487 participants from 19 clinical, laboratory and radiology parameters reached 88% accuracy (95% CI 85-91) and 84% sensitivity (95% CI 76-89), well above the sensitivity of the other classifiers tested (25-44%). It was then tested prospectively on 157 participants recruited in 2020 against drug-susceptibility testing and deployed as an app. Specificity is lower, the setting is one region, and the abstract was read only.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network on 19 clinical, laboratory and radiology parameters, deployed as the CUHAS-ROBUST screening app

evidence.tested: Prospective testing in 157 participants recruited January-October 2020 against Lowenstein-Jensen drug-susceptibility testing.
evidence.unknown: Prospective-set figures beyond the abstract, specificity, and use outside Indonesia; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Screens suspected patients for rifampicin-resistant TB without GeneXpert.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations not retrieved. Full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
